title: Plastic pollution summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): 2 million tonnes of plastic in 1950 rising to over 450 million today; ~350 million tonnes of plastic waste a year, about a quarter mismanaged; 1-2 million tonnes reach the ocean (~0.5% of waste). Figures/derivations verified consistent (450/2 ~ 225x; 350/4 ~ 88; 1.5/350 ~ 0.4%) before injecting 3 defects.
